content: अभिनीत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Brought near, conveyed. .²2 Performed, represented dramatically. .²3 Highly finished or polished, most excellent. .²4 Highly ornamented or decorated. .²5 Fit, proper, suitable (योग्य); अभिनीततरं वाक्यमित्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः <ls>Mb.</ls> .²6 Patient, forgiving, even-minded. .²7 Angry (युक्तेऽतिसंस्कृतेमर्षिण्यभिनीतः <ls>Ak.</ls> where the word may be अमर्षिणि as well while <ls>Nm.</ls> reads युक्ते तु संस्कृतेऽमर्षिण्यभिनीतः प्रचक्ष्यते). .²8 Kind, friendly. .²9 Acknowledged, agreed (प्रतिज्ञात); मित्रार्थमभिनीतार्थं यथावत् कर्तुमर्हति <ls>Rām. 4. 29. 12</ls>.
